				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			EndFor
		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			&CountUpdatedProductoId = 0
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
				Do Case
					Case &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Troquel'
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelNombre'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelNombre.ToString()

								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelEnPrensa.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelActivo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelActivo.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
				Case &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
					
					&CountKeyAttributes = 0
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
								&KeyProductoId.FromString(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue)											
								&CountKeyAttributes += 1
								If &CountKeyAttributes = 1
									Exit
								EndIf
						EndCase
					EndFor

					For Each Troquel.Producto
						Where ProductoId = &KeyProductoId

						&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = TrnMode.Update
						&CountUpdatedProductoId += 1

						For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
							Do Case
								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoId.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoNombre'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoNombre.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoClave'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoClave.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoDescripcion'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoDescripcion.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DB.ProductoCategoriaNombre.ToString()

							EndCase
						EndFor
					When None
						&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = TrnMode.Delete
					EndFor

				EndCase
			EndFor
			If &CountUpdatedProductoId < Count(ProductoId, TroquelId = &TroquelId)

				&AuditingObjectNewRecords = New()

				For Each Troquel.Producto
					Where TroquelId = &TroquelId
					&KeyProductoId = ProductoId
					&RecordExistsProductoId = False

					For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
						If &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
							&CountKeyAttributes = 0
							For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
								Do Case
									Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
										If &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue.Trim() = &KeyProductoId.ToString().Trim()
											&RecordExistsProductoId = True
											&CountKeyAttributes += 1
											If &CountKeyAttributes = 1
												Exit
											EndIf
										EndIf
								EndCase
							EndFor
						EndIf
					EndFor

					If Not (&RecordExistsProductoId)
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Mode = TrnMode.Insert
						&AuditingObjectNewRecords.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoId'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Compatible'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = True
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = DB.ProductoId.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoNombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoNombre.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoClave'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Clave'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoClave.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoDescripcion'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Descripcion'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoDescripcion.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Nombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoCategoriaNombre.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

					EndIf
				EndFor
				For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObjectNewRecords.Record
					&AuditingObject.Record.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItem)
				EndFor
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
